title: Woman on Steps with Dog, 1930s Snapshot, Black & White, USA
back_text_transcription:
To dear Nelson
April 8/36.
from Aunt Belle
description: A 1936 vintage snapshot featuring an older woman, identified as Aunt Belle, seated on marble entryway steps with a small dark dog beside her. She wears a patterned polka-dot dress typical of 1930s fashion.
